method: Fundamentals from the latest fiscal period ending on or before the anchor (Finnhub annual series). Valuation multiples recomputed from the anchor-day close and per-share fundamentals. Peer medians per Finnhub industry within this universe, falling back to the universe median where an industry has fewer than four members. Momentum from Twelve Data bars up to the anchor. Forward return over the next 252 trading days, excess return against SPY over the same window.
